info.name: GAIL Gas - Promo Index - Complete Routes
info.description: All explicit routes mounted by src/promo/routes/index.js. Read src/docs/promo-postman.md for setup, OTP/login order, uploads, callbacks and known server dependencies. JSON is sent in plaintext by default, as supported by these handlers. Set encryptRequests=true for WCF AES/HMAC envelopes; set staticKey to your deployment key. CNG authenticated requests use the key returned by CNG Login. PNG, CNG and staff tokens are separate. MFA is optional. Inspect decrypted responses in Visualize. Run workflows selectively with valid database IDs; bank handoffs require a browser and callbacks require genuine provider responses. This collection includes administrative mutations and intentional HTTP 410 retired endpoints.
